title: Iteration of the suffix step
statement: For bit strings $u$ and $v$ and a natural number $i$, applying the suffix step $i$ times to the encoding of $(u,v)$ yields the encoding of $(u,v')$, where $v'$ is obtained by deleting the first $i$ bits of $v$.
